smoke_tests.command: Follow tests/SMOKE_TESTS.md in order from a fresh install; tests 1-7 with expected outputs named per test
smoke_tests.evidence: All 7 smoke tests passed on Windows, Python 3.11.9, Claude Code v2.1.231, project-scope install. Test 1: both hooks output valid JSON with hookEventName SessionStart and non-empty additionalContext. Test 2: settings.json parsed as valid JSON, both hook entries present with absolute paths. Test 3: live SessionStart reminder contained both required anchors and excluded stale phrases. Test 4: skill created 5 slots (3 work, 2 personal) within 2-8 range. Test 5: second invocation created 0 duplicates, count remained 5. Test 6: a real beat fired at the scheduled time. Test 7: uninstall removed all package-specific installed content; fresh session showed no reminder, no skill, no slash command.

factual_runtime_claims.claim: Registering a skill invocation as a recurring beat prompt attaches the entire skill file per fire; measured on this package's ancestor at ~11,200 chars/fire, ~78k chars/day at 7 daily fires.
factual_runtime_claims.evidence: Measurement performed 2026-08-01 on the ancestor installation and carried with its date. Presented as a dated measurement of the ancestor, not as a claim re-verified on this candidate.

factual_runtime_claims.claim: In-session crons are session-scoped and auto-expire after 7 days.
factual_runtime_claims.evidence: Runtime-documented behavior, observed consistently in the ancestor installation through 2026-08. Marked in !DEPENDENCIES.md as observed-not-contractual.

factual_runtime_claims.claim: Compaction unpredictably kills or keeps in-session crons; both outcomes observed on one runtime in one day.
factual_runtime_claims.evidence: Observed 2026-08-06 (survival), 2026-08-10 (survival then later-break loss, same night), 2026-08-13 (16/16 survival). The package deliberately asserts unpredictability, not either outcome.

factual_runtime_claims.claim: The runtime's hook validator silently drops additionalContext payloads whose hookEventName is 'PostCompact'; emitting 'SessionStart' from a PostCompact registration validates and delivers.
factual_runtime_claims.evidence: Discovered 2026-05-31 in ancestry; workaround in continuous daily use since. Marked as as-of-last-verification in both the hook comment and !SPECS.md. Independent run confirmed the PostCompact hook emits SessionStart (Test 1) and the live SessionStart reminder arrived correctly (Test 3).

factual_runtime_claims.claim: Package code performs no runtime file writes. The installer/user creates the documented copies and settings entries; the skill reads the goal files and cron state and creates in-session crons; the hooks read stdin and their own package-home scripts and print JSON. The package-home hook scripts are live read dependencies at every hook fire.
factual_runtime_claims.evidence: Independent blind run confirmed: both hooks are stateless print-only scripts (Test 1); the skill's only mutations are cron registrations via CronCreate (Test 4); uninstall removed all package-specific installed content leaving only the structural settings.json skeleton (Test 7). Scope of independent verification: install, live session, and uninstall behavior on this candidate.
